subject: How do I set up automatic bill pay?
description: I'm trying to set up automatic bill pay for my mortgage payment, but I'm not sure how to do it. I have the account number and routing number, but I'm not sure which account to link it to. Also, can I schedule payments in advance? I want to make sure my mortgage is paid on time every month. I'm a new customer and this is my first time using automatic bill pay.
